hero.title: Discover Madurai, One Direction at a Time.
hero.description: Explore the temples, flavours, stories, markets and experiences that make Madurai one of Tamil Nadu's most fascinating destinations.

whyMadurai.title: Heritage
whyMadurai.desc: Discover centuries of history, architecture and traditions.

whyMadurai.title: Flavours
whyMadurai.desc: Experience authentic Madurai food and famous local delicacies.

whyMadurai.title: Culture
whyMadurai.desc: Explore festivals, crafts, traditions and everyday local life.

whyMadurai.title: Experiences
whyMadurai.desc: Discover markets, neighbourhoods, viewpoints and places beyond the usual attractions.

mustVisit.name: Meenakshi Amman Temple
mustVisit.desc: Iconic twin-spired temple, heart of Madurai.

mustVisit.name: Gandhi Memorial Museum
mustVisit.desc: Freedom struggle history housed in a former royal palace.

mustVisit.name: Thirupparankundram
mustVisit.desc: Ancient rock-cut temple, one of Murugan's six abodes.

mustVisit.name: Alagar Koyil
mustVisit.desc: Hillside temple central to the Chithirai festival.

mustVisit.name: Puthu Mandapam
mustVisit.desc: Historic pillared hall turned bustling tailoring market.

tasteOfMadurai.name: Jigarthanda
tasteOfMadurai.desc: Cooling drink with almond gum, milk and ice cream.

tasteOfMadurai.name: Kari Dosa
tasteOfMadurai.desc: Crisp dosa loaded with spicy minced mutton.

tasteOfMadurai.name: Parotta
tasteOfMadurai.desc: Layered flatbread, best with salna or curry.

tasteOfMadurai.name: Idiyappam
tasteOfMadurai.desc: Steamed rice noodles, a classic breakfast staple.

tasteOfMadurai.name: Bun Parotta
tasteOfMadurai.desc: Soft, fluffy parotta variant loved as a street snack.

tasteOfMadurai.name: Filter Coffee
tasteOfMadurai.desc: Strong South Indian coffee, brewed the traditional way.

cityStory.intro: More than a destination, Madurai is a living story.

travelTips.title: Dress Comfortably
travelTips.desc: Choose comfortable clothing and footwear when exploring temples and markets.

travelTips.title: Stay Hydrated
travelTips.desc: Keep water with you, especially while exploring outdoor attractions.

travelTips.title: Respect Local Spaces
travelTips.desc: Follow photography rules and respect temple customs.

travelTips.title: Start Early
travelTips.desc: Starting early helps you explore popular places more comfortably.
